speaker.jigoku_pilot: Shrade Eran (シュレード・エラン)
speaker.jigoku_unit: Aquarion Spada (アクエリオンスパーダ)

137:93.en: 「Care to hear the melody I play?」

137:130.en: 「I can play some fine music today.」

137:163.en: 「Now, let us play the sound of life.」

137:417.en: 「$$アマタ$$, lend me your strength too.」

137:616.en: 「Then let me play a song for you.」

137:891.en: 「Despair rules you, as it did me.」

137:932.en: 「We won't bow to your death song...!」

137:1145.en: 「No crude puppet will stop my music.」

137:1184.en: 「Can my sound reach all of you?」

137:1217.en: 「Let me deliver the melody I weave.」

137:1567.en: 「Freedom, the most beloved melody...\nI'll have it back...!」

137:1620.en: 「In a world someone rules,\nno beautiful sound is born.」

137:1669.en: 「The melody that embraces the world\nis not one you can play...!」

137:1722.en: 「To the world I love,\nyou are a dissonance...!」

alternatives: Here we go! Arpeggio of Souls!

137:2243.en: 「My life...! It plays with the moon!」
alternatives: My life...! I play with the moon!
My life...! I'll play with the moon!
My life...! I play it with the moon!
Human life...! Played with the moon!

137:2295.en: 「My soul and life ring in moonlight!」
alternatives: Soul and life ring in moonlight...!
The moon plays for us tonight...!
Those bewitched by the fair moon...!
One bewitched by the fair moon...!

137:2609.en: 「Then allow me to perform for you.」

137:2644.en: 「I'll lay a pure tone over that murk.」

137:2702.en: 「I won't offer this life for nothing.」

137:2822.en: 「My sound joins the $$神話型アクエリオン$$'s.」

137:2899.en: 「I'll guard the $$神話型アクエリオン$$'s tune.」

137:3117.en: 「I'll leave the main part to you.」

137:3136.en: 「I see. So I can only see you off...」

137:3581.en: 「Then I'll simply dodge that as well.」

137:3649.en: 「My soul is a free melody, my friend.」

137:3849.en: 「A barrier... I still have far to go.」

137:3888.en: 「I'll simply block it with my shield.」

137:3919.en: 「$$スパーダ$$ has an impregnable shield.」

137:4219.en: 「It seems our foe is quite skilled.」

137:4258.en: 「A missed note. I won't make excuses.」

137:4367.en: 「In a crisis,\na calm mind is vital.」

137:4548.en: 「It seems I must risk my life too...」

137:4583.en: 「Fine attack. My life is worn away...」

137:4673.en: 「No. I have a reason I can't retreat.」

137:4745.en: 「Heh... Your spirit fires me up too.」

137:5048.en: 「I know. I'll fight to the very end.」

137:5252.en: 「I'll take you up on that, $$アンディ$$.」

137:5557.en: 「Heh... Praise my sound, then air it.」

alternatives: Now I play the ultimate melody...!

137:5764.en: 「Will you play with me, $$カイエン$$?」
alternatives: Will you play it with me, Cayenne?
I'll play it with my friend!
I'll play this with my friend!
I play this with my friend!
From me...\nA new sound born in us!
New sound...\nborn from me, from us!
From me...\nNew sound is born in us!
New sound is born\nfrom inside us...!

137:5986.en: 「You got hit!\nDrop the damn calm act!」

137:6141.en: 「$$シュレード$$! Take my strength too!」

alternatives: My whole body is burning hot!

137:6273.en: 「Scorch the skin and sever the flesh!」
alternatives: Heat the skin and sever the flesh!
Scorch the skin, cleave the flesh!

137:6381.en: 「$$シュレード$$, can you still fight!?」

137:6675.en: 「$$シュレード$$! Let's unite our strength!」

137:6909.en: 「$$シュレード$$!\nIs that all you've got!?」

137:6958.en: 「$$シュレード$$! You wouldn't die here...!?」

137:7050.en: 「I feel my friend's soul so near...!」
alternatives: I feel my friend's soul so close...!

137:7171.en: 「This is... what $$シュレード$$ longed for!」

137:7212.en: 「$$スパーダ$$ and $$ゲパルト$$'s power as one...!」

alternatives: Haa... My heart won't stop racing!
Ahh... My heart won't stop pounding!

137:7486.en: 「Enemy dead ahead! You can do it!」

137:7585.en: 「If this keeps up,\neven $$アクエリオン$$...!」

137:7642.en: 「No! The machine can't take any more!」

137:7683.en: 「$$シュレード$$! I'll cover you too!」

137:7843.en: 「$$シュレード$$! You've got one shot left!」

137:7985.en: 「$$シュレード$$, you can't keep this up...!」

137:8020.en: 「Yes! I'll fight to the very end too!」

alternatives: Oh... My bare skin is sensitive...!

137:8155.en: 「Let's see what you can do, $$シュレード$$!」
